mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `relation` r1 INNER JOIN `relation` r2 ON r2.from_user_id = r1.to_user_id AND r2.to_user_id = r1.from_user_id AND r2.status = 0 INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r1.to_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r1.from_user_id = #{userId} AND r1.status = 0

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.avatar_url, CASE WHEN cb.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS blocked, single_conversation.conversation_id FROM `relation` r1 INNER JOIN `relation` r2 ON r2.from_user_id = r1.to_user_id AND r2.to_user_id = r1.from_user_id AND r2.status = 0 INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r1.to_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN `contact_block` cb ON cb.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND cb.blocked_user_id = u.id AND cb.status = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(cm1.user_id) AS left_user_id, MAX(cm1.user_id) AS right_user_id, cm1.conversation_id FROM `conversation_member` cm1 INNER JOIN `conversation_member` cm2 ON cm2.conversation_id = cm1.conversation_id AND cm2.user_id != cm1.user_id AND cm2.status = 0 INNER JOIN `conversation` c ON c.id = cm1.conversation_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.conversation_type = 'SINGLE' WHERE cm1.status = 0 GROUP BY cm1.conversation_id ) single_conversation ON single_conversation.left_user_id = CASE WHEN #{userId} < u.id THEN #{userId} ELSE u.id END AND single_conversation.right_user_id = CASE WHEN #{userId} < u.id THEN u.id ELSE #{userId} END WHERE r1.from_user_id = #{userId} AND r1.status = 0 ORDER BY r1.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `contact_block` cb INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = cb.blocked_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE cb.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND cb.status = 0

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.avatar_url, TRUE AS blocked, NULL AS conversation_id FROM `contact_block` cb INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = cb.blocked_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE cb.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND cb.status = 0 ORDER BY cb.updated_at DESC, cb.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
